newsletter_capability_detail: Searched signal-ai.com homepage, integrations, and the newsletters-briefings product page plus site queries for 'newsletter'. Their 'newsletters' product is an outbound analyst-curated briefing format, and their integrated source list reads: 'all sources combined: published media, podcasts, broadcast, regulatory filings, and social'. No newsletter ingestion is documented.
verified_gap: Their documented source classes are licensed published media, podcasts, broadcast, regulatory filings and social; newsletter-native content and newsletter publisher metadata are not a named input.
